parameter_or_model_selection: NONE; report every declared variant, no deployment or winner promotion
features: 64 contiguous closed M5 bars; frozen v1 native Market/Forecast. No entry-bar high/low/close in features.
baseline_parity: All 47754 baseline/no-floor native rows must match archived v1 scanner output before economic evaluation
native_proxies: atr3 lead1 enters anchor+300; atr3/atr0 open enter anchor. Native confirmation, LOCK, tick freshness, news, permissions and risk not simulated.
unrouted: ATR minimum0, maximum30, shock2.5 and overlap protection retained. SR1 forced RANGE; TP1/BR1 forced ORDERLY/EXPANSION only when native baselineFastEMA-baselineSlowEMA and baselineFastSlope agree in sign. Frozen Forecast then checks all original setup conditions. This introduces an explicit EMA direction convention outside routed regimes; it is not a pure routing-only causal experiment.
tp_ablation: Same EMA direction, ATR0/max30/shock/overlap and TP1 contract as tp_unrouted; remove exactly one of six conjunctive trigger conditions. Conditions: pullback, touch, slow_hold, body, location, reclaim. Not recommended operational policies and not estimates of causal trading benefit.
v1_hypotheses: Reuse exact three fixed closed-bar rules of v1; no changes after prior results
atr_context: ATR14 relative to median of daily mean ATR at same broker hour from last20 observed past days, minimum10 past days; current-day samples never enter baseline. Descriptive bands <=0.75, (0.75,1.25], >1.25 and UNKNOWN; no new volatility filter or chosen threshold.

binary.entry: MT4 Bid open at planned entry

forex.entry: BUY BidOpen+declared fixed spread; SELL BidOpen
forex.stop: max(1.5*closed signal ATR,6pips), rounded upward to0.00001; reject >30pips
forex.cost_interpretation: Sensitivity assumptions, not verified Exness Zero rates. Fees do not alter entry/exit paths; apply to each resolved sample. Historical spreads unknown, observed live zero is not historical proof. Swap not simulated.
forex.exit_order: Observed open stop then open take, then deadline at observed open; otherwise intrabar barriers under both declared orders. Stop gap at adverse observed price; favourable take capped. Missing interval => UNAVAILABLE unless prior bar already resolved exit.
forex.exit_time_precision: Intrabar exit timestamp is upper M5 boundary, exit_bar records containing bar. No exact tick timing inferred.
forex.one_position: Select candidate entries strictly after exit_bar of previously accepted sample; no new entry on bar occupied at its open; unavailable gap/end retains exclusion. No aggregate multi-model portfolio or USD equity.
forex.paired_holds: Same model/anchor/direction and path, requiring all3 holds RESOLVED; report paired60minus30 and120minus60. This is a diagnostic overlapping cohort, not independent trades or portfolio returns.
forex.trajectory_labels: Independent complete contiguous price trajectory through each deadline, ignoring exits: directional endpoint, gross markoutR, MFE/MAE over whole horizon. These may include prices AFTER a simulated exit and are never entry features or achievable realised P&L.

statistics.ci: descriptive95pct, unadjusted for multiple comparisons; no significance or selection claim
statistics.small_groups: Descriptive only; no minimum-frequency strategy optimisation
statistics.multiple_comparisons: 15 models x3holds x2paths x3fees x2sampling=540 FX summaries,45 BO payout summaries plus descriptive and paired contrasts. No best-cell selection.

interpretation: Positive gross/known-history references require verified costs, native tick/platform validation and genuinely new forward data. Negative proxies do not prove full EA losses. Holding limit is a hypothesis, not forecast guarantee. No operating preset changes.
